items.name: thinking-loader
items.title: thinking loader
items.description: A simple loading indicator that cycles through a list of status messages.

items.name: input-box
items.title: Input box
items.description: A rich input component for AI applications, supporting multiline text, photos uploads, and quick tool selection.

items.name: ai-message
items.title: Streaming AI Message
items.description: A dynamic message component that smoothly renders streaming AI text and automatically formats Markdown as they generate.

items.name: chain-of-thought
items.title: Chain of Thought
items.description: A sleek, terminal-like accordion block that sits above the final answer. It shows the AI's internal steps like Searching database..., Reading 3 files..., Executing Python script....

items.name: mutiple-models-input-box
items.title: Mutiple Models Input Box
items.description: A versatile chat input box featuring an integrated, categorized dropdown menu to easily switch between multiple AI models and providers.

items.name: prompt-suggestions
items.title: Prompt Suggestions
items.description: A grid of suggestion cards to help users start a conversation with the AI.

items.name: chat-layout
items.title: Chat Layout
items.description: A full-page layout block comprising a collapsible sidebar for chat history, a main chat feed area, and a sticky footer for the input box.

items.name: artifact-viewer
items.title: Artifact Viewer
items.description: A split-pane component for rendering generated code, markdown, or interactive HTML previews, complete with a code toggle and copy functionality.

items.name: inline-citation
items.title: Inline Citation
items.description: Perplexity-style [1] inline citation badges that pop open a sleek source card when hovered or clicked.

items.name: token-stats-badge
items.title: Token Stats Badge
items.description: A minimal, monospaced badge that sits at the bottom of an AI response showing tokens/sec, latency, and cost metrics.

items.name: slash-command-input
items.title: Slash Command Input
